Audacity Daily Build

PPA description

This PPA contains daily builds from audacity's git repository at
https://github.com/audacity/audacity

To install run
sudo add-apt-repository ppa:audacity-team/daily

Adding this PPA to your system

You can update your system with unsupported packages from this untrusted PPA by adding ppa:audacity-team/daily to your system's Software Sources. (Read about installing) 

sudo add-apt-repository ppa:audacity-team/daily
sudo apt update
Technical details about this PPA

This PPA can be added to your system manually by copying the lines below and adding them to your system's software sources.

Display sources.list entries for: 
deb https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/audacity-team/daily/ubuntu YOUR_UBUNTU_VERSION_HERE main 
deb-src https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/audacity-team/daily/ubuntu YOUR_UBUNTU_VERSION_HERE main
